title: Statement by the Secretary of the Treasury on the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam | U.S. Department of the Treasury
主要内容: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven T. Mnuchin participated in bilateral meetings with Egypt and Sudan's Ministers of Water Resources to facilitate an agreement on the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD). The agreement, based on legal and technical proposals from Egypt, Ethiopia, and Sudan, includes World Bank technical input. The U.S. believes the four-month process has led to a balanced and equitable agreement addressing all issues for the three countries. The U.S. Treasury Secretary emphasized the importance of an agreement before final testing and filling of the GERD. The statement highlighted concerns from downstream countries, Sudan and Egypt, regarding dam safety and the need for international standards. The U.S. reaffirmed its commitment to support the three countries until a final agreement is signed. A signed agreement on the GERD is expected to drive transboundary cooperation, regional development, and economic integration, benefiting over 250 million people in Egypt, Ethiopia, and Sudan.
